what: phao bơi: the inflatable swim ring of the people who swim at Bãi Trước, on the ground (a drawing of edits)
uses: Plan 0026, R10: a swimmer in the water holds one or sits in one; children wear one; piles of them by the steps to the sand.

drawing.name: phao_boi
sources: The swim ring of the people who swim at Bãi Trước: photos of 2019-06-22 (Flickr) and 2020-04-25 (VnExpress); 0.7 m outside, a tube of 0.2 m, a shiny plastic of one strong color (Vũng Tàu, data/world/drawings/phao_boi.json).

sources.author: Trường Hà / VnExpress
sources.shows: The south part of Bãi Trước full of swimmers at the end of the afternoon: a girl in the water inside a yellow and orange ring with a print, an orange float, yellow rings, a pink ring of a flamingo, a yellow ring of a duck, life jackets. The file is a crop of the girl in the ring.

sources.author: Flickr user 110569822@N04
sources.shows: The north part of Bãi Trước from the sand, to the north: piles of swim rings (orange, yellow, pink, and some with prints) by the steps down to the sand. The file is a crop of the piles.

outer.source: Photo 0: the ring round the girl is 240 px across (×4 crop) and her head is about 60 px (0.15 m for a child): 0.6 m. The old spec: the yellow ring that a man holds in photo 0 is about 1.4 times the width of his shoulders (0.45 m): 0.65 m to 0.7 m. I use 0.7 m.

tube.source: Photo 0: the tube of the ring round the girl is about 0.27 of the ring across (65 px of 240 px): 0.19 m on a ring of 0.7 m.

color.source: Photo 0: yellow and orange rings; photo 1 (2019): piles of orange and yellow rings, some pink; one color for each ring. A shiny plastic: the light shines on the rings in photo 0.

seams_and_valve.value: two seams of 1 cm at the outer and the inner equator; a valve of 2.4 cm
seams_and_valve.source: estimate (no source): a common swim ring of PVC; the photos are too small to show them.

looks.seen: A smooth orange torus of 0.7 m by 0.2 m, as the rings of photos 0 and 1. The outline has 16 to 20 corners, and a sharp crease of the light shows on the back of the tube (the cut to 300 triangles). The orange of the render (#b36c14 in the shade of the views) is the orange of the float in photo 0 (#ee7316 in the sun) under the light of the views.
looks.changed: Mid budget 500 and cells of 2.5 cm, far budget 80 and cells of 5 cm, so the outline is rounder.

looks.seen: The ring is rounder: the crease of the light on the back is gone. The outline still has about 18 corners, and the hole about 8; at the distance of the mid level (15 m to 40 m) the ring is 20 px to 50 px, so they do not show. Shape, proportions (0.7 m by 0.2 m, a hole of 0.3 m) and the strong orange agree with photos 0 and 1.
looks.changed: No change. Next: the near level.

looks.seen: A smooth, round torus with the shine of plastic, as the rings of photos 0 and 1; the hole is round. The seam at the outer equator shows as a broken light line (the paint is 1.2 cm wide on cells of 1 cm); the valve is a small bump on the top.
looks.changed: No change: I build the near level one time. The seams are an estimate (no source) and small.

looks.seen: The far level: a ring of about 10 corners with a hole of 5 corners, in 80 triangles, the same orange. At the far distance (40 m to 150 m) the ring is less than 15 px, so the corners do not show.
